scope: Read-only diff review of the specified deterministic session, bounded-reading prompt, owning specs and focused session tests. No production role call, external API/network, model-answer authoring, implementation edit or semantic F5 closure.

findings.title: Unseen catalog previews can cross the source-character ceiling after a near-ceiling read
findings.observed: Initial 20 previews charge 2800 characters. A complete 29200-character first source is accepted, taking characters to exactly32000. The second allowed action catalog_cursor=20 adds one unseen 140-character preview, is accepted at32140, and reports remaining_source_characters=-140.

reproduction.first_content: A repeated29199 times followed by a period
reproduction.remaining_contents: B repeated200 times followed by a period
reproduction.expected: Reject an unseen page that would exceed the cumulative ceiling before mutating catalogued_handles, counters, rows or history.

findings.root_cause: catalog() mutates catalogued_handles and preview/character counters while building cards, with no cumulative MAX_CHARACTERS validation. The strict check exists only in the reads action. These lines predate the reviewed diff.
findings.risk_limit: This is a deterministic prepared-budget/trace breach. In the current two-exchange runner, a second-exchange page result is not sent in a third selection call; no actual model source-character egress beyond32000 or citation widening was demonstrated.

positive_checks.area: immutable Registry-loaded spec and source snapshot
positive_checks.result: Focused test constructs an immutable from_dict spec; session construction succeeds, serialization hashes/signature match, nested caller metadata mutation is isolated, and copied spec parameters reject mutation.

Focused test decodes400 grouped coordinates across20 structured cards back to the previous keyed representation. Additional prior-currency/conflict/interleaved controls pass. Packing changes metadata representation only; body mapping and lineage code are unchanged by the diff.
57-source reversed-order test exposes pages0,20,40 with exact count/date bounds and only20 initial cards, without source rows or read exchanges. Direct later-page action consumes one exchange.
Page response nested limits and outer remaining_exchanges both report1 after the first action; saved history agrees. Exhaustion after the second action is enforced.

No new body-evidence or owner authority path was found in the reviewed changes. Catalog metadata remains marked metadata_is_not_evidence; raw/normalized views, read mapping and final lineage validation were not changed.

offline_tests.additional_counterexample: Executed the documented near-ceiling read then unseen-page action with network blocked; it reproduced32140 and -140.

limits: No fresh model selection/request, final output, consumer receipt or live persisted production stage was inspected or executed.
No conclusion is drawn about model comprehension of indexed fact-group dictionaries or complete outgoing token affordability. Those require exact native request and consumer evidence.
The focused coordinate-sharing test compares with _group_page, so it proves transport reversibility rather than independent correctness of the original source-group index.
Prompt instructions describe packed catalogs; ordinary keyed single-source group paging remains allowed by the owning spec. Fresh model handling of both representations is unproven.
Source-only oracle files were hash-read only and remained unchanged. Unrelated dirty files, semantic labels and historical model answers were not reviewed.
The review is deterministic counterexample analysis, not semantic/source applicability acceptance, research gain, or full F5 closure.
followup: Parent plans atomic preview validation and a red-before regression test; independent rerun remains pending.
